note: Optional mission/set grouping for blueprints. Copy this file to %APPDATA%\Citizen Assistant\blueprint_sets.json and fill it in; the user copy wins over this one. 'sets' maps a mission or pool name to either a list of blueprint names, or an object with 'source' (how you get it) and 'blueprints'. 'blueprints' assigns one blueprint at a time. Names are matched case-insensitively.
